_readme: Copy this file to mcp_servers.json and DELETE the apps you don't use (keep the JSON valid — no trailing commas). Same format as Claude Desktop, so any MCP server example online pastes straight in. Most run via npx and need Node.js (nodejs.org). Each app needs its own one-time login/auth per its README. Package names in the MCP ecosystem change often — if npx can't find one, ask JARVIS (or Cowork) to find the current package. Full walkthrough: docs/COMPUTER_AND_APPS.md

outlook._note: Microsoft Graph: mail, calendar, contacts. First run: `npx @softeria/ms-365-mcp-server --login` in a terminal for the one-time device-code sign-in. University/work account? Add '--org-mode' to both this args list and the --login command. '--preset outlook' keeps the tool count sane (~dozens); avoid '--preset all' (200+ tools) unless you need Excel/OneNote/Teams too — every extra tool costs context on every turn. docs/COMPUTER_AND_APPS.md has the full walkthrough.

canvas._note: Get a token: Canvas -> Account -> Settings -> New Access Token. Set CANVAS_BASE_URL to YOUR school's Canvas domain, not the example above.

apple._note: macOS only: Notes, Reminders, Messages, Contacts, Calendar. Grant Automation/Full Disk Access permissions when macOS prompts.
